title: 78 Gigawatts Of Nuclear Power Is Still Being Built
hook: The supposedly fading industry still has a massive construction pipeline.
closing: Projects under construction now will shape electricity supplies for decades.
question: Would you support more nuclear power?

segments.say: Nuclear construction starts reached 10 worldwide. New projects are still entering the pipeline.
China holds 50 percent of nuclear capacity under construction. The buildout is concentrated, not globally even.
About 78 gigawatts of nuclear capacity is under construction. Tomorrow's power supply is already taking shape.
